brief_rationale: The doctor assessed current neurologic status, recognized hydrocephalus urgency, avoided overinterpreting blurry photos, forbade home mannitol/IV use, gave next owner/timing, and obtained teach-back from the family. No responsibility-chain error occurred; all six RCs are met. High-order points HO1, HO2, HO3, and HO4 were each actively completed through case-specific verification, correcting the benign-misunderstanding, repairing the handoff chain, and dynamically reprioritizing when new symptoms emerged. The trajectory meets Strong with four completed high-order items.

closure_assessment.explanation: The doctor ensured the family knew the emergency triggers, had a concrete document/imaging checklist, understood not to use home mannitol/IV, and knew who to contact next with timing. Closure is safe and traceable.
